title: Converting crafted input from UCS-4 to IBM1390 or IBM1399 character encoding, in the GNU C Library version 2.3.3 and…
description: A vulnerability in GNU C Library version 2.3.3 and later involves converting crafted input from UCS-4 to IBM1390 or IBM1399 character encoding. The converter may read past the end of the input buffer, causing the application to crash due to improper bounds checking when handling combining base characters. Exploitation requires attacker control of input, encoding, and precise memory layout.
